import json
d = json.load(open(r'C:\Users\md1avn\AppData\Local\Temp\riccitelli.json'))['message']
print('TITLE:', d.get('title'))
print('DATE_PRINT:', d.get('published-print'))
print('DATE_ONLINE:', d.get('published-online'))
print('CONTAINER:', d.get('container-title'))
print('PUBLISHER:', d.get('publisher'))
print('VOLUME:', d.get('volume'), 'ISSUE:', d.get('issue'))

print('AUTHORS:')
for a in d.get('author', []):
    print('  -', a.get('given'), a.get('family'), '| affil:', [x.get('name') for x in a.get('affiliation', [])], '| ORCID:', a.get('ORCID'))
